description: DISC SELECT prefix candidates for the RX-driven harness xs8_disc_select_sweep.py. Logical ROOT TX bytes. Every byte is in the 169-byte ROOT no-visible-effect union (research/notes/xs8-key-release-candidates.md); known, dangerous, context-active and ambiguous bytes are excluded by construction and again by the harness. Ranking: research/XS8_COMMAND_COVERAGE.md ROOT columns, see the DISC SELECT candidate review of 2026-10-16.

tested.physical: NEGATIVE: no disc change; 0x48 was read as track 4 (operator observation)
